title: BinSlot
description: This mod adds a trash can slot to your inventory, allowing you to quickly and safely dispose of unwanted items. Type "/trash" in chat to open the new inventory with the new bin can slot.
body:
## 🗑️ BinSlot – Crafting Table With Automatic Trash Slot

**BinSlot** is a Minecraft mod that adds a custom crafting table featuring a special "bin slot". This slot automatically handles leftover items produced during crafting, helping reduce inventory clutter.

### 🔍 How It Works

When crafting recipes that generate extra items (like empty buckets or bottles), BinSlot will attempt to return them to your inventory. If there's no available space, those items will be discarded automatically using the bin slot.

This behavior mimics the crafting logic of vanilla Minecraft, but improves usability for players who craft large amounts of items or play with recipe-heavy modpacks.

### 🧰 Features

- A custom crafting table with a standard 3x3 grid
- An extra output slot for handling recipe results
- Automatic cleanup of leftover items (e.g. buckets, bottles)
- Supports all vanilla Minecraft recipes
- Helps avoid manual inventory management during crafting

### 🛠 Requirements

- Minecraft Java 1.21.3
- Forge 53.1

### 📌 Notes

- The mod uses Minecraft's standard recipe system.
- It does not require any other mods to function.
- BinSlot is a lightweight quality-of-life addition, especially useful in survival and modded environments.

### 🔧 Future Plans

Planned features may include:
- Customization options for trash behavior
- Compatibility with other mods
- Integration with recipe automation tools

---

If you find a bug or have suggestions, feel free to share them in the project’s issue tracker or discussion page.
